name: phrase-mappings
title: Design persona-specific backchannel phrase-response mappings
description: Phrase-response mappings inside the existing Filler words drawer: several caller phrases map to one deterministic acknowledgment, kept exactly as typed so the voice pronounces it right. Priority ordering, whole-utterance or within-utterance matching, conflict validation, and a persona override that replaces the global set.
